Titre H2 · Why I made Paleo Pro
Paragraphe · "I couldn't find a protein powder that m
blocks_element.text: "I couldn't find a protein powder that matched the way I ate. So I made one."

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · After a life-altering accident left him
blocks_element.text: After a life-altering accident left him unable to walk, Doug rebuilt his body with real food. No fillers, no shortcuts. He went looking for a clean protein powder that matched the way he ate. He couldn't find one.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Paleo Pro started in his kitchen with on
blocks_element.text: Paleo Pro started in his kitchen with one goal: real food protein, the way humans have always eaten, nothing else. Over a decade later we're in Sprouts and Whole Foods nationwide, and the formula hasn't changed. Two clean proteins. One complete scoop. The same way since day one.

blocks_element.repere: Texte · What does Paleo Pro taste like? +
blocks_element.text: What does Paleo Pro taste like? +

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Better than you'd expect from a beef pro
blocks_element.text: Better than you'd expect from a beef protein — honestly. The flavored options (Aztec Vanilla is our bestseller) use natural flavors and monk fruit: no chalky aftertaste, no artificial sweetness. Plain Naked is completely neutral, made for smoothies, coffee, or baking.

blocks_element.repere: Texte · Is it really just five ingredients? +
blocks_element.text: Is it really just five ingredients? +

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Yes. Grass-fed beef protein isolate, egg
blocks_element.text: Yes. Grass-fed beef protein isolate, egg white protein, cold-pressed sunflower lecithin (a pinch so it mixes smooth), monk fruit extract, and natural flavor. Plain Naked skips the monk fruit and flavor, so it's just three. No fillers, no gums, no artificial sweeteners. We list every ingredient because we have nothing to hide.

blocks_element.repere: Texte · Will it upset my stomach like whey does?
blocks_element.text: Will it upset my stomach like whey does? +

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Paleo Pro is 100% dairy-free, soy-free,
blocks_element.text: Paleo Pro is 100% dairy-free, soy-free, and gluten-free. No lactose, no bloating, no gut issues. If dairy proteins wreck your stomach, this was made for you.

blocks_element.repere: Texte · Is it Whole30, paleo, and keto compatibl
blocks_element.text: Is it Whole30, paleo, and keto compatible? +

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Yes to all three — and carnivore-friendl
blocks_element.text: Yes to all three — and carnivore-friendly too. No grains, no dairy, no legumes, no added sugar. Just clean animal protein.

blocks_element.repere: Texte · How much protein is in a scoop? +
blocks_element.text: How much protein is in a scoop? +

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · 26g of complete protein per scoop, with
blocks_element.text: 26g of complete protein per scoop, with about 120 calories and 0–1g of carbs. It's one of the cleanest protein-to-calorie ratios you'll find in any powder.

blocks_element.repere: Texte · How is this different from plant protein
blocks_element.text: How is this different from plant protein? +

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Plant proteins typically need 10–20 ingr
blocks_element.text: Plant proteins typically need 10–20 ingredients to approximate a complete amino acid profile, and many cause bloating. Paleo Pro delivers complete protein from just beef and egg white — naturally bioavailable, easy to digest, with all nine essential amino acids.

blocks_element.text: What if I don't like it? +

blocks_element.text: Can I save with a subscription? +

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Yes — Subscribe & Save takes 15% off eve
blocks_element.text: Yes — Subscribe & Save takes 15% off every order and ships free. Pause, skip, or cancel anytime. No commitments, no hassle.

blocks_element.repere: Texte · Why subscribe instead of buying one bag
blocks_element.text: Why subscribe instead of buying one bag at a time? +

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Because protein only works when it's the
blocks_element.text: Because protein only works when it's there every morning. A subscription means the bag lands before the last one runs out, so the habit never breaks — and you pay 15% less for it, with free shipping on every order. You choose the cadence (every 30, 45, or 60 days), you can swap flavors between deliveries, and pausing or cancelling takes one click, no phone call. Subscribers also get first dibs when a new flavor or limited batch drops.
